title: ARM64 Ardueno Vulkan crash
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.6.1

### System information

Windows 11 - Godot 4.6.1.stable - Vulkan (Forward+) - Ardueno (arm64 microsoft surface laptop 7)

### Issue description

Hi, I sometimes develop on my windows surface laptop 7 (arm64). I recently moved to 4.6.1 and eventually tried to develop on laptop. Editor crashes when using Vulkan in Forward+. It doesn't crash with OpenGL (Forward+), D3D12(Forward+) and Vulkan Mobile.

 Fails here ERR_FAIL_COND_V_MSG(err, PipelineID(), "vkCreateGraphicsPipelines failed with error " + itos(err) + ".");

with err = 387965008 

Found a shader that causes this issue. Shader's code. It is too large hence the link to pastebin https://pastebin.com/bP9TrnEZ

Calling this method more than once makes it fail. Right now it's called only once, but before there were 5 layers. If I add any layer back or just calling apply_mask_layer second time it starts failing when I try to open material with this shader or scene containing this shader. I couldn't reproduce it in brand new project, even though I tried.

I made process dump available with debug symbols and can share it through some secure way if development team wants to look at it. it's 1.8 GB ZIP file.

```
apply_mask_layer(final_color, n, uv, ddx, ddy, wp,
m5_enabled, m5_mask_tex, m5_use_gradient, m5_overlay_gradient, m5_use_overlay_tex, m5_overlay_tex,
m5_overlay_strength, m5_mask_scale, m5_invert_mask_depth, m5_hole_depth, m5_lower_threshold, m5_upper_threshold,
```
